PART I - FINANCIAL INFORMATION
Item 1. Financial Statements

Note 1 - Basis of presentation

These statements are unaudited and condensed as permitted by the rules of the SEC for interim reporting.

Note 2 - Revenue and Concentration

One customer accounted for 30% of revenue in the quarter, and a distributor for 22% of receivables.

Item 2. Management's Discussion and Analysis

Sales to our distributor rose during the quarter as it restocked its warehouses ahead of the holiday season.

Gross margin was flat. Sales to our largest customer were steady and one supplier raised prices.

Item 3. Quantitative and Qualitative Disclosures About Market Risk

None material to our business at this time.

PART II - OTHER INFORMATION
Item 1. Legal Proceedings

We are not party to any material legal proceedings at this time, and none is threatened against us.

Item 1A. Risk Factors

We depend on a limited number of suppliers for components, and a shortage at any of them could delay shipments of our products to customers.
